performanceSummary: Strict zoom performance remains failed against unchanged 50 ms input-to-layout and 33 ms steady-timer budgets. The 30-second campaign measured p95 input 51.3154 ms and steady timer 61.2394 ms. Completion is not performance acceptance. These synthetic offscreen measurements do not measure physical input-to-display latency or certify absence of leaks.
